articles.summary: In what is a recurring feature, Finopotamus profiles interesting and intriguing tech professionals who are positively impacting the credit union industry. For this issue, we visited with NCR Atleos’ Chief Data Officer Maha Sivara. With approximately 20,000 employees, the Atlanta-based fintech bills itself as providing an unrivalled ATM experience for financial institutions, retailers and self-service consumers.
articles.title: Finopotamus: Tech People in the Know: NCR Atleos’ Maha Sivara

articles.summary: First Citizens Bank today announced an agreement with NCR Atleos to provide clients with surcharge-free access to ATMs at more than 2,000 Target stores. The nationwide rollout provides First Citizens’ customers with a flexible, convenient, and secure way to access everyday banking at participating Target locations.
articles.title: First Citizens Bank to collaborate with NCR Atleos to provide ATM access at Target stores nationwide

articles.summary: Why Credit Unions Need a Business-First Data Strategy. Guest Editorial by Maha Sivara, Chief Data Officer, NCR Atleos. Credit unions across the country continue to invest heavily in data modernization, whether through cloud migrations, new analytics platforms, AI initiatives or system integrations. However, many institutions struggle to answer how these investments will improve member outcomes.Maha Sivara, Chief Data Officer, NCR Atleos.The challenge is that a credit union’s data strategy too often becomes synonymous with their technology strategy. Credit unions focus on building platforms, streamlining systems or implementing new tools without first identifying the problem they want to solve. The end result is typically significant investment without measurable impact, creating frustration for all involved and limiting the value of these modernization efforts.
articles.title: Finopotamus: Why Credit Unions Need a Business-First Data Strategy

articles.summary: Regions Bank on Tuesday announced the launch of a treasury management solution with Clip Money and NCR Atleos that enables businesses to deposit cash through more than 8,100 Clip Money locations across the U.S., extending deposit access beyond Regions Bank’s branch network.
articles.title: Regions Bank expands treasury management capabilities through Clip Money and NCR Atleos

articles.summary: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”) will release third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Wednesday, November 4, 2026.Due to the pending transaction with The Brinks Company, NCR Atleos will not be hosting an earnings conference call to review the third quarter or issue a financial outlook.
articles.title: NCR Atleos Announces Date of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results
